verdict.rationale: Codex is presented as an agentic coding assistant that runs tasks, edits files, and returns diffs/PRs — a delegated-task model rather than an inline, as-you-type completion/next-edit experience like Copilot's ghost-text suggestions. No evidence describes inline completions or next-edit suggestions while typing; IDE integration is mentioned only as a place to invoke the agent, not as an autocomplete feature.
